parts.label: National tide
why: Gallup party identification moved from Republicans 48 Democrats 45 in the third quarter of 2024 to Democrats 50 Republicans 39 in the third quarter of 2026, 14 points toward the Democrats.
This district moves 1.12 points for every point the nation moves, so it feels about 15.7 points of that tide, a tailwind for Yassamin Ansari.
